state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: Classifying responses as correct, incorrect or abstain, the paper reports judges are most accurate when not shown arguments and not strongly encouraged to abstain, and least likely to be incorrect when shown arguments and strongly encouraged to abstain. A 2x2x2 repeated-measures ANOVA (+/- argument x 1st/2nd judgment x incentive structure) with abstentions removed shows no main effects and no interactions.
title: No significant effect of arguments, judgment round or incentive on binary judge accuracy
